brand.name: NovaTech
brand.description: Software company helping teams manage workflows effectively and securely
brand.mission: Help teams manage their workflows more effectively with intelligent, reliable tools
brand.tagline: Intelligent workflow orchestration for modern teams

prohibitedTerms.explanation: NovaTech is positioned as an enterprise-grade, high-value solution. 'Cheap' degrades brand perceived value.
Absolutist claims like '100% bug-free' create legal warranties and are technically unverifiable.
Contradicts approved brand SLA: NovaTech Enterprise offers 99.9% uptime SLA, never 100%.
Hyperbolic and sensationalist claims undermine professional enterprise trust.
'Hack' connotes unstable workarounds or security vulnerabilities.
Aggressive, combative language conflicts with NovaTech's collaborative, professional tone.
Uncapped permanent commitments violate enterprise licensing standards and legal terms.
prohibitedTerms.replacement: scalable capacity designed for enterprise growth

prohibitedTerms.explanation: Demeans end-users and overpromises operational infallibility.
Informal and slightly dismissive colloquialism unsuitable for enterprise communications.
Hostile rhetoric that exposes the company to disparagement risks.

preferredTerminology.explanation: Use 'cost-effective' or 'high-ROI' to convey value without sounding discount-oriented.
Emphasize intelligent automation and engineering rigor rather than 'magic'.
Standard enterprise framing for multi-stage automated pipelines.
Professional call to action for commercial engagements.
Accurately communicates enterprise governance without indefensible claims.

approvedFacts.statement: NovaTech was founded in 2021 by workflow automation specialists.
NovaTech is certified for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II data security standards.
NovaTech provides a guaranteed 99.9% uptime SLA exclusively on Enterprise tiers, backed by service credits.
NovaTech offers a 14-day free trial on all plans with no credit card required.
NovaTech is actively deployed across more than 10,000 teams and businesses worldwide.
NovaTech natively integrates with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Asana, and GitHub.
24/7 dedicated priority support is included exclusively on Enterprise plans. Standard plans receive business-hours support.
All customer data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256.

contradictions.explanation: Contradicts NovaTech's official 99.9% uptime SLA. Guaranteeing 100% uptime creates severe contractual and regulatory risk.
NovaTech's approved trial policy is strictly 14 days. Mentioning 30 or 60-day trials misleads prospective buyers.

contradictions.contradicts: FACT-002 (HIPAA is currently NOT in our certified compliance list)
contradictions.explanation: NovaTech holds ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications. HIPAA compliance is not currently certified and cannot be promised.
Inflates customer count beyond verified metrics (approved count: over 10,000 teams).

contradictions.contradicts: FACT-004 (NovaTech is a commercial SaaS product with a 14-day trial, not freemium)
contradictions.explanation: NovaTech does not offer a permanent free tier. All tiers transition after the 14-day evaluation.

unsupportedPatterns.explanation: Unsubstantiated superlative claims require documented third-party award or analyst report (e.g. Gartner/Forrester) citation.
Specific financial outcome guarantees violate consumer protection guidelines unless backed by audited case studies.
Vague security hyperbole ('military-grade', 'unhackable') is discouraged by security compliance boards.

voiceAttributes: Professional: Credible, articulate, and respectful of enterprise standards
Friendly: Accessible, collaborative, and human rather than robotic or stiff
Clear: Direct, active voice, avoiding unnecessary jargon or buzzwords
Empowering: Focused on customer productivity and team success

channelAdjustments.ads: Crisp, benefit-driven, high urgency without false scarcity or hyperbole
channelAdjustments.social: Conversational, engaging, community-focused, maximum 3 relevant hashtags
channelAdjustments.emails: Personalized, courteous, structured for quick scanning, clear call to action
channelAdjustments.blogs: Authoritative, educational, thought-leadership depth with practical takeaways
channelAdjustments.product_specs: Precise, unambiguous technical language, explicit configuration bounds
